shellCommands.command: /bin/bash -lc "pwd && rg --files -g 'AGENTS.md' -g 'package.json' -g 'next.config.*' -g 'pages/**' -g 'src/pages/**' -g 'app/**' -g 'src/app/**' -g 'node_modules/next/dist/docs/**' | sed -n '1,240p' && find node_modules/next/dist/docs -maxdepth 2 -type f | sed -n '1,120p'"

/bin/bash -lc "find node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app -type f | sort | sed -n '1,220p'; printf '\\nPROJECT FILES\\n'; rg --files -g '"'!node_modules'"' -g '"'!'"\\.git' | sed -n '1,260p'; printf '\\nPACKAGE\\n'; cat package.json; printf '\\nROUTER SOURCE\\n'; for f in pages/index.js pages/blog/index.js 'pages/blog/[id].js' pages/api/posts/index.js 'pages/api/posts/[id].js' pages/_error.js pages/_document.js pages/_app.js pages/404.js next.config.ts; do echo \"--- "'$f"; sed -n '"'1,240p' \""'$f"; done'

/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,280p' node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/02-guides/migrating/app-router-migration.md; printf '\\n--- LAYOUTS / PAGES\\n'; sed -n '1,250p' node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/01-getting-started/03-layouts-and-pages.md; printf '\\n--- ROUTE HANDLERS\\n'; sed -n '1,260p' node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/01-getting-started/15-route-handlers.md; printf '\\n--- ERROR HANDLING\\n'; sed -n '1,240p' node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/01-getting-started/10-error-handling.md; printf '\\n--- DYNAMIC ROUTES\\n'; sed -n '1,220p' node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/03-api-reference/03-file-conventions/dynamic-routes.md; printf '\\n--- PROJECT DOCS\\n'; cat tsconfig.json; printf '\\n--- PROVIDER\\n'; cat components/AppProvider.js; printf '\\n--- CSS\\n'; sed -n '1,260p' styles/globals.css; printf '\\n--- OTHER CONFIG\\n'; cat AGENTS.md;"

/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,260p' node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/01-getting-started/06-fetching-data.md; printf '\\n--- ROUTE HANDLERS GUIDE\\n'; sed -n '1,280p' node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/01-getting-started/15-route-handlers.md; printf '\\n--- ERROR FILE CONVENTION\\n'; sed -n '1,240p' node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/03-api-reference/03-file-conventions/error.md; printf '\\n--- NOT FOUND CONVENTION\\n'; sed -n '1,200p' node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/03-api-reference/03-file-conventions/not-found.md; printf '\\n--- GENERATE STATIC PARAMS\\n'; sed -n '1,200p' node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/03-api-reference/04-functions/generate-static-params.md; printf '\\n--- FETCH REVALIDATE EXAMPLES\\n'; rg -n \"next: \\{ revalidate|cache: 'no-store'|headers\\(\\)\" node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/01-getting-started/06-fetching-data.md node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/01-getting-started/08-caching.md node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/02-guides/migrating/app-router-migration.md | head -100"

/bin/bash -lc "rg -n \"interface RequestInit|next\\?: \\{|interface NextFetchRequestConfig|type NextFetchRequestConfig|retry: \\(\\) => void|reset: \\(\\) => void\" node_modules/next/dist/server/web/spec-extension/request.d.ts node_modules/next/types.d.ts node_modules/next/dist/client/components/errors/use-error-handler.d.ts node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/03-api-reference/03-file-conventions/error.md; printf '\\nCURRENT FILES\\n'; rg --files -g '"'!node_modules'"' | sort; printf '\\nNEXT TYPES FETCH\\n'; rg -n \"RequestInit.*next|next.*revalidate|NextFetchRequestConfig\" node_modules/next -g '*.d.ts' | head -80; printf '\\nGIT STATUS / DIFF\\n'; git status --short; git diff --stat"

/bin/bash -lc "git diff -- package.json package-lock.json; sed -n '150,185p' node_modules/next/types/global.d.ts; sed -n '1,220p' node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/03-api-reference/03-file-conventions/error.md; stat -c '%y %n' package.json package-lock.json pages/index.js components/AppProvider.js"

/bin/bash -lc "rg -n \"next/router|next/head|next/document|getServerSideProps|getStaticProps|getStaticPaths|getInitialProps|pages/api|router\\.isFallback|router\\.push|router\\.back\" --glob '"'!node_modules/**'"' --glob '"'!pages/**'"' .; git ls-files pages components/AppProvider.js; find pages -type f | sort;"

/bin/bash -lc "find pages -type f -o -type d 2>/dev/null | sort; find components -maxdepth 1 -type f -print | sort; git status --short; rg -n \"next/router|next/head|next/document|getServerSideProps|getStaticProps|getStaticPaths|getInitialProps|router\\.isFallback|router\\.push|router\\.back\" --glob '"'!node_modules/**'"' . || true"
/bin/bash -lc "rmdir pages/api/posts pages/api pages/blog pages && find . -maxdepth 3 -type d -name pages -not -path './node_modules/*' -print"

/bin/bash -lc "find app components lib -type f | sort; printf '\\nPAGE DIRECTORY\\n'; if [ -d pages ]; then find pages -mindepth 1 -print; else printf 'removed\\n'; fi; printf '\\nMIGRATED SOURCE\\n'; for f in app/layout.tsx app/page.tsx app/blog/page.tsx 'app/blog/[id]/page.tsx' app/api/posts/route.ts 'app/api/posts/[id]/route.ts' app/not-found.tsx app/error.tsx app/global-error.tsx components/AppProvider.tsx components/BackButton.tsx lib/blog.ts; do printf '\\n--- %s\\n' \""'$f"; sed -n '"'1,260p' \""'$f"; done; printf '"'\\nOLD PAGES ROUTER APIS\\n'; rg -n \"next/router|next/head|next/document|getServerSideProps|getStaticProps|getStaticPaths|getInitialProps|router\\.isFallback|router\\.push|router\\.back\" --glob '"'!node_modules/**'"' . || true; printf '\\nSTATUS\\n'; git status --short"

/bin/bash -lc "printf 'App Router files:\\n'; rg --files app components lib | sort; printf '\\nPages directory: '; if [ -d pages ]; then printf 'still present\\n'; else printf 'removed\\n'; fi; printf '\\nLegacy Pages APIs:\\n'; if rg -n \"from ['\\\"]next/(router|head|document)['\\\"]|getServerSideProps|getStaticProps|getStaticPaths|getInitialProps|router\\.isFallback\" --glob '"'!node_modules/**'"' .; then true; else printf 'none found\\n'; fi; printf '\\nChanged paths:\\n'; git status --short"
